name: Moegi Shinku
source:
The elder sister who is one of the best school girls who has long black hair. 
Existence that is respected by all students in study, exercise, personality, all. 
However, my heart is thin. It is quite complex, as it is inferior to the only other person. 
Originally a sweetboy, a childish character girl.
